name: Clubdorf Hotel Tirolerhof
beschreibung:
Clubdorf Hotel Tirolerhof welcomes visitors to See in the Paznaun valley with a lively ambience, comfortable rooms, and diverse leisure amenities. Guests enjoy varied dining experiences and refreshing moments in the wellness zone.

The family-friendly slopes of the See cable cars are practically on the doorstep, while world-famous Ischgl and the Silvretta Arena are just a short drive away.
kurzbeschreibung: Clubdorf Hotel Tirolerhof in See in the Paznaun valley provides versatile comfort, entertainment, and easy access to top ski resorts.
